preserved_staged_file_metadata_only.role: exact retained before-product staging from terminal recovery-001

eight_criterion_assessment.identity: The exact product and scene IDs remain frozen. The terminal code reports a text-MTL mismatch but does not say which key was absent, duplicated, malformed, or different.
eight_criterion_assessment.authority: The owner's recovery-001 approval ended at a terminal failure; it grants no further content read or reinterpretation. A new exact decision is required for a distinct diagnostic process.
eight_criterion_assessment.access: The preserved staged file exists by metadata only. The two Downloads originals remain untouched; neither is a substitute input for the proposed diagnostic.
eight_criterion_assessment.rights: USGS describes Collection 2 Level-2 delivery with MTL text and XML metadata; no new provider request, account action, or terms acceptance is proposed.
eight_criterion_assessment.provenance: The retained staged SHA-256 was recorded during the consumed recovery. A future diagnostic must first remeasure and match that exact digest before interpreting any MTL field; this still does not create an upstream provider checksum.
eight_criterion_assessment.integrity: The current verifier reached MTL text identity after copying and hashing, but it did not produce an identity-key diagnostic receipt. A bounded TAR-header and two-MTL-field read is proposed, not archive revalidation or promotion.
eight_criterion_assessment.fitness: The proposed classification can guide a later reviewed correction or rejection, but cannot establish source authenticity, TIFF/header/pixel quality, AOI coverage, or map usability.
eight_criterion_assessment.privacy_security: The process must never log a raw MTL body, unexpected arbitrary field value, private path, signed URL, account identifier, token, or payload byte. Only allowlisted product/scene identifiers and fixed codes may be recorded.
